title: Rabbi Avshalom the Elder (a Tanna)
author: Aharon Hyman
attribution: Model-assisted translation, editorially reviewed; publication authorized by Joshua Waxman.

paragraphs: Mentioned in Mekhilta, Beshalach, Vayehi, chapter 3. Perhaps he is the father of Rabbi Natan mentioned in a baraita in Berakhot 22a. The Vilna Gaon's reading, however, is Rabbi Avtilos, as also in Shemot Rabbah 21:8.[^1]

notes.text: Shemot Rabbah 21:8 names Rabbi Avtolis the Elder, beside Hyman's Avtilos. Berakhot 22a names Rabbi Natan ben Avishalom. These forms do not establish Hyman's tentative father identification. The intended Mekhilta passage and the reported Vilna Gaon reading could not be directly established here and remain attributed reports; no name is silently substituted.
